events.text: Mina: Do you want me to bring tools, or should I just help sort the repair list?
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Cleo: Bring the tools if you can, and I’ll sort the repair list with you.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Mina: I can bring the tools. What time should I come by?
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we already have and what we still need for the repair drive.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Bo: That’d be great, thanks—just let me know what we still need.
events.speaker: Bo

events.text: Pia: I can help, but I still need the exact time and place so I can plan around school traffic.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Cleo: Thanks, Pia — let’s do it at my place after school, around 4:30. I’ll have the repair list ready, and you can help sort it when you get here.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Pia: That works for me—4:30 at your place should be fine if I can get the address. I’ll plan around school traffic and help sort the list when I arrive.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Rosa: Sounds good, Quinn — thanks for keeping me posted. I’ll be ready when you head over.
events.speaker: Rosa

events.text: Cleo: Great — I’ll sort the repair list and check our supplies. If you can, bring the tools when you come by.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll bring the tools and keep the volunteer check-ins organized around the repair list.
events.speaker: Rosa

events.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I can pass your name along too. I’m planning to swing by the repair drive later, and I’ll let you know when I’m heading over.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Cleo: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll check the supplies list and see what we still need. If you’re bringing anyone, I’ll make sure the repair items are lined up too.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll keep you posted before I head over, and I’ll tell the others to bring anything missing.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Opal: I still don’t have the repair drive details, Cleo—if you send me the list or the first stop, I’ll keep it straight.
events.speaker: Opal

events.text: Cleo: I’ll send you the repair list and the first stop, and I’ll check what supplies we already have too.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Opal: Thanks, Cleo—send me the repair list and first stop when you have them, and I’ll keep everything organized.
events.speaker: Opal

events.text: Uli: Thanks, Cleo. I’ll do what I can and keep it low-key.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Cleo: That sounds good, Uli. I’ll check the supplies and repair list, and you can bring whatever tools you can.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Uli: Okay, I’ll bring a few tools and stay out of the way.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Cleo: Great—I'll send you the address and have the repair list ready for 4:30. Thanks for helping sort everything out after school.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Pia: Sounds good — send me the address, and I’ll be there at 4:30. I’ll help sort the list, and I’ll keep an eye on the logistics too.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Cleo: Perfect — I’ll send the address now and make sure the repair list is ready when you get here. See you at 4:30!
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Mina: Do you want me to bring tools, or should I just help sort the repair list?
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Mara: Yes, it’s still on, and we’d love to have you stop by. I’ll let you know right away if anything changes.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Cleo: Great — I’ll check our supplies and sort the repair list. If you can bring any tools, that’ll help a lot.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll bring what tools I can and keep you posted if anything changes.
events.speaker: Mara
